preconditions.description: The number of engineers N must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= current_desk <= 2 * N and 1 <= desired_desk <= 2 * N for current_desk, desired_desk in desks)
preconditions.description: Each engineer's current and desired desk numbers must be within the range from 1 to 2*N.

preconditions.expression: len(set(current_desk for current_desk, _ in desks)) == N
preconditions.description: All current desk numbers must be unique among the engineers.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of valid seating arrangements modulo 1000000007.
